title: Continuous prioritized prefetch orchestrator for mixed-turn prompt/response workloads
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: production traffic shows a large variance in prompt vs response length (short prompts, very long responses and vice versa) leading to inefficient GPU slab usage and high KV cache churn. This ticket implements a continuous batching scheduler enhancement called the 'Prioritized Prefetch Orchestrator' (PPO) that: 1) computes per-request prefetch budgets based on turn-priority decay, expected remaining tokens, and historical KV residency; 2) quarantines slots for high-residency long-response turns to avoid interleaving evictions; 3) merges complementary short-turn requests into elastic minibatches when latency headroom exists. Goal: reduce end-to-end token cost by 12% and tail p95 generation latency by 18% on mixed-turn production traces while keeping 99th percentile latency SLO violations <= existing baseline.
background: We currently use a slot-based continuous batcher with first-fit packing and a simple KV eviction watermark. Mixed-turn workloads cause small short-turn requests to fill slots and evict the KV entries of longer-turn requests mid-generation. Previous tickets addressed various packing heuristics and KV-watermark tuning but did not coordinate prefetch budgets or treat long-residency turns specially. See related tickets for context (ENG-17048, ENG-22111, ENG-42109).
implementation_notes:
High-level components:
- TurnPriorityEstimator: lightweight model that uses request metadata (dialog position, user id, past length distribution) and recent runtime telemetry to estimate expected remaining tokens.
- PrefetchBudgetAllocator: computes prefetch tokens to warm KV shards and reserve slab segments. Budget includes an adaptive margin proportional to estimated remaining token variance.
- SlotQuarantineManager: when a turn is classified as long-residency, guarantee contiguous GPU slab reservation using soft quarantine timeouts and a spill policy into ephemeral compressed KV if quarantine fails.
- ElasticMinibatchMerger: opportunistically aggregates many short-turn requests into a merged work item if observed per-request latency slack > configured threshold.
- KV Warmup Pipeline: background prefetch into on-GPU KV cache with priority lanes to avoid blocking tail-critical generation.

Data-plane integration points:
- Batcher admission: consult PrefetchBudgetAllocator at admission time and annotate request with prefetch tokens.
- Runtime eviction hook: SlotQuarantineManager registers to eviction events and attempts to extend quarantine or trigger background offload.
- Metrics: new histograms for kv_prefetch_tokens, quarantine_hits, quarantine_evictions, minibatch_merge_rate, and slab_fragmentation_ratio.

Compatibility: Must be togglable behind runtime feature flag and support dedicated/private deployments where KV offload APIs are restricted.
acceptance_criteria: A/B experiment on production-like trace shows >=12% reduction in median per-token GPU memory churn compared to current baseline
p95 generation latency reduced by >=12% and p99 not worse than baseline
No increase in error rates or OOM incidents during 72h smoke test
Feature toggle exists and can be disabled without restart; observability dashboards show new metrics
Unit + integration tests for estimator, allocator, and quarantine manager included and passing in CI
decisions: Use a simple linear-turn-priority estimator instead of a learned model in the initial rollout to reduce inference overhead and risk
Quarantine will be implemented as a soft reservation with a 2s default hold time, tunable per-tier
Background KV offload uses LZ4 compressed slots stored in device-host pinned memory when on-prem KMS or network constraints prevent cloud offload
Elastic minibatch merging limited to requests with expected remaining tokens < 64 and latency headroom > 20ms by default
blockers: Need KV offload API signoff from Private deployments team (security review pending)
GPU slab reservation primitives require a small change to the allocator kernel (ENG-334413) before full quarantine semantics can be supported
Bench infra for reproducing mixed-turn traces in dedicated environment is flaky (infra ticket INFRA-902)
test_plan: Local unit tests for TurnPriorityEstimator with synthetic length distributions
Simulator run: feed replay of 48h production trace into batcher sim with and without PPO to validate slab fragmentation and KV hits
Canary rollout to 1% of traffic on staging region; run synthetic long-response stress tests
72-hour canary on dedicated capacity with telemetry collection: slab fragmentation ratio, kv_prefetch_tokens, quarantine_evictions, p50/p95/p99 latencies
Regression tests for OOM avoidance: fuzzed parallel long-turns and short-turns under peak load
